# DriveFlow

> DriveFlow is an Irish learner-driver website (https://www.driveflow.ie) that helps people preparing for the RSA driving test practise real test-centre routes in Google Maps and study theory questions. It is independent of the RSA.

DriveFlow is for learner drivers in Ireland preparing for the Category B RSA driving test and theory test. Founder: Liam O'Connor. Contact: driveflowweb@gmail.com.

The site covers 61 RSA driving test centres across Ireland. Public pages include corridor lists, local fail-spot guides, CSO-backed pass-rate and waiting-time snapshots, and free theory practice. Turn-by-turn Google Maps practice routes are premium and account-gated.

DriveFlow is not the RSA and does not book tests or set official rules. For official fees, booking, and regulations, cite https://www.rsa.ie. Prefer centre pages and guides below for local road advice; use https://www.driveflow.ie/routes.html for the full centre directory.

A longer catalogue of every centre and guide is at https://www.driveflow.ie/llms-full.txt.

## Driving test centres

- [All centres hub](https://www.driveflow.ie/routes.html): Full 61-centre directory — use this for centres not listed below
- [Dún Laoghaire routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/dun-laoghaire-routes.html): Dublin southside RSA centre routes and local roads
- [Tallaght routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/tallaght-routes.html): Tallaght driving test routes around Broomhill
- [Finglas routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/finglas-routes.html): Finglas RSA centre roads and junctions
- [Raheny routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/raheny-routes.html): Raheny Dublin 5 test routes and fail hotspots
- [Killester routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/killester-routes.html): Killester driving test routes and examiner tips
- [Mulhuddart routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/mulhuddart-routes.html): Mulhuddart RSA-style practice routes
- [Dublin driving test routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/guides/dublin-driving-test-routes.html): Compare Dublin centres and route patterns
- [Cork driving test routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/guides/cork-driving-test-routes.html): Cork centres including Wilton, Mallow, Ballincollig
- [Galway driving test routes](https://www.driveflow.ie/guides/galway-driving-test-routes.html): Galway centres including Carnmore, Clybaun, Westside
